title: Panel-close via S silently fails when a pipe is selected, contradicting the panel's own hint
detail: The chip-click path opens the panel regardless of selection, but with a pipe selected S is never collected, so the on-panel 'S / tap chip to close' affordance is dead in that reachable state (Esc/chip still work).
recommended_fix: Collect S whenever inp.panel_open is true (before the sel_pipe gate), or gate the collection on !panel_open only for the open direction; alternatively correct the hint text.

title: Active-mode chip text never reflects reduced-motion-only activation
evidence:
settings_chip_rect:
	scaled := v.ui_scale > 1.001 || v.palette.mode != .Off || v.reduced_motion
	a11y_chip_text:
	#partial switch v.palette.mode {
	case .Deutan:  return "A11Y: DEUTAN" if v.ui_scale <= 1.001 else "A11Y: DEUTAN 125%+"
	case .Protan: return "A11Y: PROTAN" if v.ui_scale <= 1.001 else "A11Y: PROTAN 125%+"
	case .Tritan: return "A11Y: TRITAN" if v.ui_scale <= 1.001 else "A11Y: TRITAN 125%+"
	case:         return "A11Y: 125%+" if v.ui_scale > 1.001 else "A11Y SETTINGS (S)"
	}
detail: With reduced_motion on, mode Off, scale x1.00, `scaled` is true but a11y_chip_text returns the neutral 'A11Y SETTINGS (S)' — the active-mode chip carries no indication that reduced motion is live.
recommended_fix: Add a reduced-motion leg to a11y_chip_text (e.g. 'A11Y: REDUCED MOTION' when only motion is active) so every active mode surfaces in the chip.
